newsitem.title: UK: Croat Pliva H1 pretax 368.3 mln kuna.
newsitem.headline: Croat Pliva H1 pretax 368.3 mln kuna.

text.p: Croatian pharmaceuticals company Pliva dd pretax profit rose to 368.3 million kuna in the first half of 1996 from 246.4 million in the year ago period, the company said in a statement.
Total turnover rose 15.1 percent to 1.23 billion kuna from 1.069 billion and net income rose 27.6 percent to 283.9 million from 222.5 million.
"The business environment in which Pliva conducted business in the first half of 1996 did not significantly change with respect to 1995," the company said.

Pliva is the world's fifth largest manufacturer of Vitamin C and sells 40 percent of its output overseas. It also has one world-class drug, an antibiotic sold in Western Europe and the Americas as Zithromax under license from Pfizer Inc and as azithromycin in central and eastern Europe.
Pliva was the first Croatian firm to launch a global share-offering when its global depositary receipt (GDR) issue was 20 times oversubsribed in March.
Its GDRs, which are listed on the London Stock Exchange, are trading at $52.25 compared with $18.71 at the launch. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
